trial: C9 the co-expressing Fst and Runx2 fibroblast population

rules.question: the pre-registered version of trial C8's post hoc observation
rules.answerable: does a co-expressing Fst and Runx2 fibroblast population exist in an independent injury dataset with animals, and what else marks it
rules.not_answerable: whether Areg deletion depletes it; one library per genotype and no other Areg-flox fibroblast dataset exists, so this is stated rather than approximated
rules.fibroblast_gate: Col1a1 detected, Ptprc and Pecam1 and Epcam not detected, as in C6 and C8
rules.T1: co-detection ratio against independence plus a permutation null within deciles of genes per cell (200 permutations, seed 0); the permutation unit is the CELL, so it is a statement inside one animal. GROUP RULE: co-organised only if ratio >= 1.25 and permutation p < 0.05 in BOTH bleomycin libraries
rules.T2: double-positive share higher in both bleomycin than both untreated libraries, as in E4
rules.T3: descriptive: top 30 genes by detection difference between double-positive and double-negative fibroblasts of the Areg-flox/+ library, floor 0.1, the pair itself excluded; one library and cells are not replicates, so no P value
rules.T4: a T3 gene replicates if its detection difference has the same sign and at least half the magnitude in both bleomycin libraries; the reported quantity is how many of the top genes replicate
rules.T5: depth control: the ratio must not move by more than 0.25 between the shallow and deep halves at the median genes per cell, or that library's ratio is not read

reading_fixed_in_advance.T1_passes: a co-expressing population exists in injury without an oncogene; the C8 observation is not a one-library artefact, and T3 with T4 says what marks it
reading_fixed_in_advance.T1_fails: the C8 observation does not replicate in an independent injury dataset and the lead closes, whatever T3 shows
reading_fixed_in_advance.T2_met: the population is injury-induced rather than resident
reading_fixed_in_advance.T5_fails: that library's ratio is not read

rules.unit: the animal; two per group in GSE132771 and one library per genotype in GSE316244, so no P value on any group comparison

results.reading: the C8 observation does not replicate in an independent injury dataset and the lead closes, whatever T3 shows the population is injury-induced rather than resident Depth control failed for Bleo1_GFPp, Bleo2_GFPp, whose ratio is not read.
